info.name: Zemen - Dual Calendar API
info.description: Full integration test suite. Run top-to-bottom. Login auto-saves {{token}}; Create Event saves {{event_id}} and {{event_version}}. Uses a timestamp-generated email so re-runs never fail on duplicate registration.

item.name: Access protected route - no token (expect 401 or 403)

exec: // Fetch current version fresh before updating to avoid stale version issues
pm.sendRequest({ url: `${baseUrl}/events/${eventId}`, method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }, (err, res) => {
pm.test('Each participant has email', () => parts.forEach(p => pm.expect(p).to.have.property('email')));
pm.test('Each participant has role',  () => parts.forEach(p => pm.expect(p).to.have.property('role')));
pm.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: email, password: 'ViewerPass1!', full_name: 'Viewer User' }) });
pm.test('NFR-S1: Viewer cannot update event - 403', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('NFR-S1: Viewer cannot delete event - 403', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.sendRequest({ url: `${baseUrl}/events/${eventId}`, method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }, (err, res) => {
pm.test('NFR-S1: Editor can update event - 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('NFR-S1: Editor cannot delete event - 403', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('Google OAuth not configured (env vars missing)', () => true);
